title: Which firewall features need Advanced Firewall
aliases: user group criteria not available firewall

checks.do: Whether the license allows the criterion when a rule with a user, group, department or network application, or an IPS rule, cannot be created.

identity-and-apps-need-advanced.statement: Configuring and applying firewall policies based on users, groups, departments or network applications requires Advanced Firewall.

quotes: Advanced Firewall is required to configure and apply policies based on users, groups, departments, or network applications

ips-needs-advanced.statement: IPS Control is available only with Advanced Firewall.

quotes: IPS Control is available only with Advanced Firewall

standard-tier-has-rules.statement: A standard-tier tenant can hold Firewall Filtering rules, up to the standard-tier cap.
standard-tier-has-rules.conditions: Assumes a published per-tier rule cap means rules can be created on that tier; no source states this in so many words. Which criteria those rules may use is open (standard-tier-criteria).

standard-tier-criteria.title: Which other criteria work on the standard tier
standard-tier-criteria.detail: The old reference tabulated Location, Network Services and Source/Destination IP criteria as available on the standard tier. No captured source states this; the only tier-gated criteria in the captures are users, groups, departments, network applications and IPS Control. Neither the captures nor the SDKs say what the API returns when a standard-tier tenant submits a gated criterion.
standard-tier-criteria.blocks: telling an operator whether a rejected rule is a license problem
